tool.list.definition: {"name":"list_executions","description":"List recent executions for the tenant (newest first, paged — executions are an unbounded history). Omit cursor on the first page. Use only filters justified by the task; do not invent status, channel or date bounds. When the user names a workflow, first resolve it with get_workflow/find_workflow and pass workflow_id; never treat the tenant-wide latest execution as evidence for a named workflow. started_from/started_to narrow to a window on the start time (the window `get_operating_figures` counts over), status to one outcome. `total` is the exact count under the given filters; while `has_more` is true, pass `next_cursor` back verbatim as `cursor` with unchanged filters for the next page. A failed read is missing evidence, not an empty history.","category":"tenant_read","strict":false,"permission":null}
tool.get.definition: {"name":"get_execution","description":"Fetch one execution by id (full row including status, timestamps and `caller`: who started it, how SubKit verified them, over which channel, and the originating run for nested runs) plus its structured `outcome`: kind (succeeded / failed / held = writes held in a preview, nothing written / partial = a tolerated step failure / running), the failed step, its cause class and error code, step counts, and the output-contract verdict.","category":"tenant_read","strict":null,"permission":{"action":"execution:read","resourceType":"execution","resourceIdArg":"id"}}
